notablePrerequisites:
Scythe of the Wretched attached to Gilded Goose.
You control at least two Foods.
description:
Activate Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar by sacrificing two Foods, causing Gilded Goose to deal six damage to itself.
Gilded Goose dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Scythe of the Wretched triggers, returning Gilded Goose from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Scythe of the Wretched to it.
When Gilded Goose enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two Food tokens.
Repeat.
